body:
**What is this feature?**

If `useComboboxFloat` gets a duplicate size measurement, skip any re-render. When the `Combobox` is not open, do not run `autoUpdate` in `useComboboxFloat`.

**Why do we need this feature?**

https://floating-ui.com/docs/useFloating#whileelementsmounted specifically notes that `autoUpdate` should not be used for floating UI that will be hidden with CSS (including in a collapsed `details`), only when the UI as a whole is conditionally rendered.

When `Combobox` is rendered in a collapsed `details`, as is the case in the Feature Control UI, `useComboboxFloat` was receiving continual size measurements from `autoUpdate`. This was then causing `setPopoverMaxSize` to be continually called, even though the values stored were identical. That then caused React to re-render the underlying `input`, and even though no attributes changed, due to React internals, there was a DOM update on every re-render.

**Who is this feature for?**

Developers.

**Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**:

N/A

**Special notes for your reviewer:**

Please check that:
- [ ] It works as expected from a user's perspective.
- [ ] If this is a pre-GA feature, it is behind a feature toggle.
- [ ] The docs are updated, and if this is a [notable improvement](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/#how-to-determine-if-content-belongs-in-whats-new), it's added to our [What's New](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/) doc.
title: Combobox: Ensure useComboboxFloat does not cause excessive rerenders
